allchars.description: Include all characters in index/search (default: only alphanums + space)

basename.description: Basename for output files (basename.dict, basename.index); required

break_headwords.description: Write multiple headwords on separate lines

columns.description: Line-wrap width for definitions (0 or negative disables wrapping)

database_short.description: Database short name (optionally with version/date); overrides 00-database-short header

database_url.description: Source URL of the raw database; overrides 00-database-url header

headword_separator.description: Separator used to split multiple headwords (e.g., '%%%')

index_data_separator.description: Separator between index and data columns in .index file (octal string)

index_keep_orig.description: Preserve original headword in 4th index column (for UTF-8)

mime_header.description: MIME header to prepend to definitions on OPTION MIME

without_header.description: Do not copy header to DB info entry

without_headword.description: Do not include headwords in .dict file

without_time.description: Do not copy creation time to DB info entry

without_url.description: Do not copy URL to DB info entry
